# Open Graph Image

Create an `og-image.png` file (1200x630 pixels) for social media sharing.

## Recommended Design

- **Size**: 1200 x 630 pixels
- **Format**: PNG
- **Content**:
  - ClasherStats logo
  - Tagline: "Clash of Clans Statistics Tracker"
  - Some troop/hero artwork
  - Dark background matching the app theme

## Tools to Create

- [Canva](https://canva.com) - Free online design tool
- [Figma](https://figma.com) - Free design tool
- [OG Image Generator](https://og-image.vercel.app/) - Quick OG images

## Usage

Place the `og-image.png` file in this `/public` folder. It will be served at:
`https://clasherstats.vercel.app/og-image.png`
